must_cover: Language deprivation risk applies to hard-of-hearing children too, not only children considered 'fully deaf'

must_cover: The highest-leverage, lowest-cost intervention is starting visible sign language immediately: no medical prerequisite, no insurance gatekeeping, no surgery, no device cost
Starting sign now protects the critical period regardless of how costlier medical pathways (CI, therapy) unfold later
Free IDEA Part C early intervention services exist and can begin right away
